# variants of lifo: cap_asc, root reverse, initialize q order reverse
base=open('tmp/genfast_d3.py').read().replace('key=self.q.popleft()','key=self.q.pop()')
mods={
 'lifo_capasc':base.replace("for y in sorted(list(self.Hadj[x].keys())):","for y in sorted(list(self.Hadj[x].keys()), key=lambda yy:(self.Hadj[x].get(yy,0),yy)):"),
 'lifo_capdesc':base.replace("for y in sorted(list(self.Hadj[x].keys())):","for y in sorted(list(self.Hadj[x].keys()), key=lambda yy:(-self.Hadj[x].get(yy,0),yy)):"),
}
# reverse initial roots: initial q built from sorted roots then append; need reverse list
mods['lifo_revroot']=base.replace("        self.q=q","        from collections import deque as _dq\n        self.q=_dq(reversed(list(q)))")
for name,s in mods.items():open('/workspace/tmp/'+name+'.py','w').write(s)
